enrichment.summary: Measures N and H are local funds for college and career readiness, and the Measures N and H Commission recommended this change. Oakland School for the Arts would reduce its classroom materials and supplies line from $8,000 to $3,500 and use $4,500 for a consultant contract with Education Media LLC. The text does not describe the services.

enrichment.headline: Moves $100 within Oakland High's college and career funds to cover Sacramento and LA trip lodging
enrichment.summary: Measures N and H are local funds for college and career readiness, and the Measures N and H Commission recommended this change. Oakland High School would reduce its materials and supplies line from $6,961.24 to $6,861.24 and add $100 to the travel line, raising it to $11,061.24. That line pays for hotel rooms for Law and Social Justice Academy students on an overnight field trip to Sacramento and Los Angeles.

enrichment.headline: Adds $50,302 for Anthonio's inspection services on the Coliseum College Prep expansion
enrichment.summary: This amendment to the inspector-of-record agreement with Anthonio, Inc. covers inspection services for the Coliseum College Preparatory Academy Site Expansion Project. The total not-to-exceed amount is $575,826, which includes $50,302 for additional services. The added work starts March 12, 2026 and continues until the project is complete.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: This amendment to the master agreement for material testing and special inspection services is with Applied Materials & Engineering Inc. for the Coliseum College Preparatory Academy Site Expansion Project. The total not-to-exceed amount is $161,718, which includes $16,171.80 for additional services. The added work starts March 12, 2026 and continues until the assigned project is complete.

enrichment.headline: Adds $12,425 and about 11 months for DSK Architects' West Oakland Middle School window replacement design
enrichment.summary: This amendment gives DSK Architects $12,425 more for additional architectural and engineering design work on the West Oakland Middle School Window Replacement Project, raising the limit from $689,885 to $702,310. It also extends the agreement by 334 days, from July 31, 2025 to June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
